items.title: Keysight (KEYS) Up 0.8% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
items.summary: Keysight (KEYS) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: Does Keysight (KEYS) Have the Potential to Rally 29.93% as Wall Street Analysts Expect?
items.summary: The average of price targets set by Wall Street analysts indicates a potential upside of 29.9% in Keysight (KEYS). While the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric is questionable, the positive trend in earnings estimate revisions might translate into an upside in the stock.

items.title: Should You Buy Synopsys Stock While Its Cash Runs Far Ahead Of Its Profit?
items.summary: Synopsys (SNPS) sells the design software and the interface IP that chip makers need to get AI silicon built, and its stock has still gone backwards over the past year. At about $370 the shares sit at their 52-week low. Reported margins have fallen sharply over the past year. Free cash flow tells a different story, and the gap between cash and reported profit is the case worth arguing here.

items.title: What Would Cadence Have To Keep Doing To Justify Its Price?
items.summary: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) trades at 54.5 times trailing earnings. A multiple that high is a requirement rather than an opinion. The price only works if the business grows into it, and you can work out exactly how much growth it takes. The harder question is whether that calculation deserves your trust here.

items.title: Keysight (KEYS): Buy, Sell, or Hold Post Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: Keysight has followed the market’s trajectory closely, rising in tandem with the S&P 500 over the past six months. The stock has climbed by 9.6% to $313.37 per share while the index has gained 13.7%.

items.title: Keysight's 56% Order Jump Puts AI Demand and Q4 Guidance in Focus
items.summary: KEYS Q3 orders surged 56% as AI infrastructure and connectivity demand grew, but supply constraints could limit near-term revenue conversion.

items.title: Should Investors Buy KEYS as Growth Surges but Valuation Looks Mixed?
items.summary: KEYS enters fiscal 2026's final stretch with faster AI-led growth and rising estimates, while valuation remains above broader market benchmarks.

items.title: Keysight Falls 11.1% in 3 Months While AI Demand Keeps Accelerating
items.summary: KEYS shares fell 11.1% in three months despite surging orders and earnings, as AI demand meets supply, policy and valuation risks.
